description: Fixed-point approximation of 2^(x / 128) with a parabolic correction of the fractional part, 0 for x < 0 and INT32_MAX from x = 3967 (silk_log2lin)
notes: Opus 1.5.2, silk_log2lin (silk/log2lin.c), with silk_SMULBB, the 64-bit silk_SMLAWB selected on x86-64 by OPUS_FAST_INT64 (celt/arch.h), silk_MLA and the shift macros inlined. Written by us from the function. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake: two range checks, the correction term, and the two size-dependent scalings computed and selected: 22 IR instructions. Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
